column1: # Build 7 -- the high-bit encoding, no engine patch.
# Every Latin byte is written as (ASCII | $80), so each pair is >= $A0A0:
#   main CPU $1342 BMI       -> bit 15 set -> TEXT path        (was the bug)
# and no byte can ever be $0D/$21/$23/$24/$63, so nothing is reserved.
# AROUND is the exact test that failed in build 4: English, word-for-word,
# at the ORIGINAL 13/9 line breaks. Only the encoding differs.
# BARKEEP: 4 original Japanese, then English, then 4 original Japanese --
# the build 6 sandwich that lost its tail. Full-width and half-width now
# both take the main CPU's text path, so the trailing Japanese should return.
